claim: The mission toolchain runs end to end on a B200: the KataGo v1.18.2 CUDA-backend binary passes `version` and `runtests`, carries sm_100 SASS, and evaluates a transformer (SwiGLU-FFN) net through both `benchmark` and a `gtp` genmove on a 9x9 board; and the same architecture trains under torch 2.11.0+cu128 on the GPU (forward+backward, non-zero finite gradient) at pos_len 9.

assumptions: The smoke exercises a randomly-initialised net, so it certifies the toolchain and the transformer code paths, not any playing strength.
b7c96h3tfrs stands in for the eventual 9x9 architecture; it is the smallest config in python/katago/train/modelconfigs.py whose blocks are SwiGLU ('ffnsg'), which the CUDA backend requires.
The exported .bin is written by export_model_pytorch.py with pos_len 19 (hard-coded at export); board size is a run-time property of the engine, so the same file serves 9x9 play.
cuDNN comes from the nvidia-cudnn-cu12 pip wheel inside R/venv; anything running the binary must keep that lib dir on LD_LIBRARY_PATH, which R/env.sh does.

open_obligations: [OPEN] The 9x9 selfplay/train node must set cpp/configs/training/selfplay1_maxsize9.cfg:16 dataBoardLen and python/selfplay/train.sh:88 -pos-len to 9 together (data_processing_pytorch.py:91 asserts the npz row width matches pos_len); both still read 19 upstream and were NOT touched by this build.

notes: The sm_100 gap is real and silent: cpp/CMakeLists.txt:761 sets CMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES with a plain set(), which shadows -DCMAKE_CUDA_ARCHITECTURES, and its CUDA 12.8 list stops at 90/120. An unpatched build ran only via compute_90 PTX JIT; after the patch cuobjdump reports 2 sm_100 ELFs.

name: Slurm chain wrapper + mission loop copy encode the 3-day-walltime resume contract and repair three upstream defects (static)

claim: results/ktg/paper_1902.10565/codes/loop/loop.sbatch plus the mission copies synchronous_loop_9x9.sh and export_model_for_selfplay_9x9.sh encode the run contract (1 GPU, 24 CPUs, 120G, --time 2-23:30:00 inside the 3-day MaxTime, b300-preferred/b200-fallback, self-resubmit with --dependency=afterany by absolute path, .failcount breaker at 3 with a 600 s minimum-runtime penalty, STOP brake, chain-depth cap) and repair the three upstream defects that make the stock synchronous loop unrunnable or lossy here: the binary is copied from $KATAGO_BIN (cpp/build/katago) rather than the path the CMake build never produces (synchronous_loop.sh:81), SELFPLAY_CONFIG/GATING_CONFIG point at the mission 9x9 configs rather than the mixed-board-size presets (:70-71), and the export copy renames the temp into the target before removing the source, inverting the window in which upstream export_model_for_selfplay.sh:89 destroys the checkpoint ahead of its rename at :108. The files exist, parse, and grep as stated; the binary-copy and config-resolution repairs were executed in a dry run. Behaviour under a real job, a real kill, or a real failure chain is NOT shown here.
